label: Family overview to gate
negative_prompt: hard cuts, heavy blur, low quality, distorted text, invented signs, fake QR code, new gate numbers, extra signage, warped illustration, jitter
prompt: Create a smooth 5 second continuous camera glide from the full Hong Kong airport family-route overview into the final boarding gate waiting frame. Follow the family route from the overview toward the gate without rotating the camera, keeping the movement calm and practical for a parent-child airport guide. clean HKIA-style isometric airport route map, mobile 9:16, white and pale-blue architecture, dark blue dotted passenger route, numbered route markers, premium travel assistant look. Do not add fixed gate numbers, flight times, shopping brands, extra lounge claims, or new factual signage. End exactly on the destination frame composition.
